**Install:** download Prty.zip, unzip it, move Prty.app to Applications and open it. Needs macOS 15+ and a logged-in [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com) (`gh auth login`).

Prty isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Prty.app`.
